title: SkillsFuture Programme Attendees Who have Procured Work Related to Their Course
what_it_is: SkillsFuture Programme Attendees Who have Procured Work Related to Their Course

sections.label: Job placements and training places
sections.summary: In 2019, about 7,000 placements came through Professional Conversion and Work-Study programmes, and 2,400 through Train-and-Place; 2020 offers up to 30,000 training places.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In 2019, almost 7,000 job placements were achieved through the Professional Conversion Programmes and Work-Study programmes provided by Workforce Singapore and SkillsFuture Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Another 2,400 placements were achieved through Train-and-Place programmes in 2019, where trainees received assistance from the training providers upon completion of the course.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In 2020, we are offering up to 20,000 training places under the SGUnited Skills programme and another 10,000 places under the SGUnited Mid-Career Pathways (Company Training) programme.

sections.label: Graduate employment and trainee performance
sections.summary: In 2019, 87% of surveyed Work-Study graduates were in full-time jobs within six months, and over 80% of surveyed trainees performed better at work after SkillsFuture training.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In 2019, 87% of the surveyed graduates were employed in full-time jobs within six months after completing the Work-Study Programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: More than 80% of the trainees surveyed in 2019 indicated that they were able to perform better at work after undergoing SkillsFuture training.

sections.label: SkillsFuture Ambassadors partnership
sections.summary: Partnerships with several agencies have started to build a pool of SkillsFuture Ambassadors who provide face-to-face services and advisory to jobseekers seeking SkillsFuture training opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: More recently, we have started partnership with several agencies to build a pool of SkillsFuture Ambassadors.These ambassadors provide face-to-face and personal services and advisory to jobseekers who want to know where these SkillsFuture training opportunities are.
